name: A docket at Addle’s Stead

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

summary: Backus directs the search to Addle’s Stead and verifies the recovered docket.
description: Watcher Backus recalls unusual Defias activity around Addle’s Stead. The farm lies apart from Stormwind’s ordered streets, its fields dark beneath Duskwood’s clouded canopy. A search of the hideout yields a docket from a chest. Backus can tell that the papers are authentic, but the matter has grown beyond local watchwork. He returns the evidence to Elling, who can read its wider implications.
